name: Red Rice
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it's easily digestible and low in fermentable fibers compared to other whole grains.
preparationTips: Rinse thoroughly before cooking to remove excess starch
Cook with 1.5-2 cups water per cup of rice for optimal texture
Soak for 30 minutes before cooking to reduce cooking time
Add a pinch of salt while cooking to enhance natural nutty flavor
pairsWellWith: Fresh herbs like cilantro and parsley
Olive oil and lemon juice dressing
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of fiber for digestive health
Contains B vitamins and minerals like manganese
Provides complex carbohydrates for sustained energy
